enemies.name: Prisoner
enemies.description: A fellow inmate, chained and half-starved, lashing out at anything that moves.

enemies.name: Giant Rat
enemies.description: Fed well on whatever the ritual left behind, and grown far past its size.

enemies.name: Crazy Prisoner
enemies.description: Driven mad long before the ritual, and worse now that something's finally listening to him.

enemies.name: Guard
enemies.description: A revived guard in full kit, shield raised out of muscle memory alone.

enemies.name: Fat Prisoner
enemies.description: Swollen with whatever the ritual fed him, and furious that you interrupted his meal.

enemies.name: Butcher
enemies.description: The kitchen's last cook, still working with what's left in the larder.

enemies.name: Knight
enemies.description: A knight in full plate, sword and shield still gripped tight, guarding an armory with nothing left to protect.

enemies.name: Demon
enemies.description: Something the ritual called up and never fully controlled, still chained to this room.

enemies.name: The Sorcerer
enemies.description: Refuse his errand and he will burn you where you stand. Twenty wards, two barriers every breath.

enemies.name: The Inquisitor
enemies.description: A former interrogator, alive and far worse for it, guarding the chapel's door out.

enemies.name: The Prison Warden
enemies.description: Symbol of the old order, risen to keep it intact by any means left to him.

enemies.name: The Resurrected Anarchist
enemies.description: The revolution he never finished, twisted into something that answers to the ritual instead of his cause.
